verdict.rationale: GitHub confirms Firecrawl is open source under AGPL-3.0 and that the hosted cloud version adds extra features, meaning self-hosting is genuinely possible. However community feedback notes the self-hosted/open-source version has functional gaps (e.g., no built-in proxy service, limited daemon capabilities, missing HTML/screenshot support), so self-hosting works but with meaningful caveats compared to the cloud offering.
